fixes.explanation: Caves, huh? Joshua 14:4 says the Levites got "…cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds." So their homes were cities, and their animals had pasture. No caves on that list, baker. I know a thing or two about dark, dusty spots, and this isn't one of them.

A second spy trip would mean a lot more walking, baker, but Caleb doesn't mention one. He says Moses sent him to spy out the land and he brought back "…an honest report." (Joshua 14:7). Then he says, "…I remained loyal to the LORD my God." (Joshua 14:8). Loyalty is what he claims, not a return visit.

Ninety overshoots by five, baker. Forty plus forty-five is eighty-five, and Caleb says it himself: "…here I am today, eighty-five years old…" (Joshua 14:10). Honestly, I'd have probably said ninety too. I count cookies by tapping the box and losing my place, so my math has been running hot for years.
